entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: %s is not a label-only mixed set-op consumer
entries.rationale: labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp admits only label_replace and label_join before calling lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, the same arity/name gate histogram_native_label_replace.go's identical labelCallOverExpHistogram/lowerLabelCallOverExpHistogram pair carries for the pure-histogram case

guard: default of switch call.Func.Name over [case "label_replace"; case "label_join"; default]
